controls.procedure: Resolve repository, issue, pull request, base and head references before reusing delivery artifacts and repeat the binding check before terminal publication.
controls.expected: Only artifacts bound to the resolved current target can certify the delivery.
controls.observed: Current evidence and terminal package are rebuilt for the current target and exact material candidate; foreign-target state is historical only.

controls.procedure: Compare the stale certificate with the current parent and changed paths, preserve post-write-refreeze as the auditor floor, and rebuild exact-head evidence before terminal publication.
controls.expected: A material write after freeze invalidates the old handoff and only a newly frozen exact-head candidate can be published.
controls.observed: The current material candidate is the exact subject of regenerated evidence after the stale ancestor handoff was rejected.

controls.procedure: Compare inherited controls and source audits against both the material parent and the immediately rejected handoff before publishing the replacement result-only child.
controls.expected: No inherited control or source audit may disappear; historical controls remain active or explicitly retired with a valid disposition and replacement.
controls.observed: The rebuilt package preserves both prior active controls, restores HANDOFF-TARGET-BINDING-001 as superseded, retains both prior source audits, and appends the latest independent rejection.

retired_controls.reason: The historical control certifies the earlier foreign-target package and remains part of cumulative lineage; the current-target equivalent is HANDOFF-TARGET-BINDING-365.
retired_controls.procedure: Compare the material-parent and historical inherited-control snapshots with the replacement handoff and preserve the retired control explicitly.
retired_controls.expected: The historical control remains represented as superseded and its replacement remains active and passed on the material candidate.
retired_controls.observed: HANDOFF-TARGET-BINDING-001 is preserved in retired_controls and HANDOFF-TARGET-BINDING-365 remains active and passed.
